title: Fixture Chapter
voicePrompt: In your own words, explain what this chapter teaches about how the prophecies of Daniel and Revelation were meant to be understood, and why their study matters now.

questions.stem: According to the chapter, when did the book of Daniel's prophecy begin to be unsealed?
options: At the time of the end, beginning 1798
questions.explanation: The chapter ties the unsealing to 'the time of the end,' which it dates from 1798, when the book would be opened and better understood.

questions.stem: How does the chapter say Smith's structural observations should be treated?
options: As observations about the text itself
questions.explanation: The convention is to surface structural findings as observations about the text — 'notice the structure' — not as opinions to cite.
